```{r}
#merge all pedon data: 
#clean ncss_pedon:
ncss_pedon <- ncss_pedon %>%
  select(siteobsiidref, upedonid, taxonname, taxclname, taxonkind, pedontype, pedbiidref, grpiidref, peiid, POINT_X, POINT_Y) 
  
ncss_ped_taxa <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  select(peiidref, taxonname, taxonkind, seriesstatus, taxclname,taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize, taxpartsizemod, taxceactcl, taxreaction, taxtempcl, taxmoistscl,taxtempregime, petaxhistoryiid)

str(ncss_pedon)
str(ncss_ped_taxa)


# 1) Make ONE taxonomy row per pedon
taxa_best <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    # clean blanks -> NA
    across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(str_trim(.x), "")),
    filled = rowSums(!is.na(across(c(
      taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize, taxclname, taxonname
    ))))
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiidref) %>%
  arrange(desc(filled), desc(petaxhistoryiid)) %>%  # most complete; then newest history id
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2) Left join to your Coastal Plain pedon table
pedon_taxa <- ncss_pedon %>%
  left_join(
    taxa_best %>%
      select(peiidref, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
    by = c("peiid" = "peiidref")
  )

# quick QC
pedon_taxa %>%
  summarise(
    pedons = n(),
    pedons_with_tax = sum(!is.na(taxorder) | !is.na(taxsubgrp)),
    pct_with_tax = pedons_with_tax / pedons * 100
  )


pedon_taxa2 <- pedon_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    # normalize blanks
    taxonname = na_if(str_squish(taxonname), ""),
    taxclname = na_if(str_squish(taxclname), ""),
    taxclname = ifelse(taxclname == "Not Classified", NA_character_, taxclname),

    across(c(taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
           ~ na_if(str_squish(.x), "")),

    # series name key:
    # - squish spaces
    # - uppercase for matching consistency
    taxonname_key = toupper(taxonname),

    # pretty version for display (Title Case)
    taxonname_clean = str_to_title(taxonname_key)
  )

series_tax_lookup <- pedon_taxa2 %>%
  group_by(taxonname_key) %>%
  summarise(
    taxorder    = first(na.omit(taxorder)),
    taxsuborder = first(na.omit(taxsuborder)),
    taxgrtgroup = first(na.omit(taxgrtgroup)),
    taxsubgrp   = first(na.omit(taxsubgrp)),
    taxpartsize = first(na.omit(taxpartsize)),
    taxclname   = first(na.omit(taxclname)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
pedon_taxa_filled <- pedon_taxa2 %>%
  left_join(series_tax_lookup, by = "taxonname_key", suffix = c("", "_series")) %>%
  mutate(
    taxorder    = coalesce(taxorder,    taxorder_series),
    taxsuborder = coalesce(taxsuborder, taxsuborder_series),
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, taxgrtgroup_series),
    taxsubgrp   = coalesce(taxsubgrp,   taxsubgrp_series),
    taxpartsize = coalesce(taxpartsize, taxpartsize_series),
    taxclname   = coalesce(taxclname,   taxclname_series)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_series"))
pedon_taxa_filled %>%
  summarise(
    pedons = n(),
    series = n_distinct(taxonname_key),
    taxorder_filled = sum(!is.na(taxorder)),
    taxsubgrp_filled = sum(!is.na(taxsubgrp)),
    pct_taxorder = mean(!is.na(taxorder)) * 100
  )

# Which series still have no taxonomy?
pedon_taxa_filled %>%
  group_by(taxonname_key) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), any_taxorder = any(!is.na(taxorder)), .groups="drop") %>%
  filter(!any_taxorder) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

```{r}
# 1) Ensure clean keys + blanks -> NA
pedon_taxa_filled2 <- pedon_taxa_filled %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname_key = toupper(str_squish(taxonname_key)),
    across(c(taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize),
           ~ na_if(str_squish(.x), "")),
    taxclname = ifelse(taxclname == "Not Classified", NA_character_, taxclname)
  )

# 2) Build per-series lookup of "best available" values
series_lookup <- pedon_taxa_filled2 %>%
  group_by(taxonname_key) %>%
  summarise(
    taxclname   = first(na.omit(taxclname)),
    taxorder    = first(na.omit(taxorder)),
    taxsuborder = first(na.omit(taxsuborder)),
    taxgrtgroup = first(na.omit(taxgrtgroup)),
    taxsubgrp   = first(na.omit(taxsubgrp)),
    taxpartsize = first(na.omit(taxpartsize)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3) Fill missing values from the series lookup (only within same series)
pedon_taxa_seriesfilled <- pedon_taxa_filled2 %>%
  left_join(series_lookup, by = "taxonname_key", suffix = c("", "_series")) %>%
  mutate(
    taxclname   = coalesce(taxclname,   taxclname_series),
    taxorder    = coalesce(taxorder,    taxorder_series),
    taxsuborder = coalesce(taxsuborder, taxsuborder_series),
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, taxgrtgroup_series),
    taxsubgrp   = coalesce(taxsubgrp,   taxsubgrp_series),
    taxpartsize = coalesce(taxpartsize, taxpartsize_series)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_series"))

# QC
pedon_taxa_seriesfilled %>%
  summarise(
    pedons = n(),
    series = n_distinct(taxonname_key),
    missing_taxclname = sum(is.na(taxclname)),
    missing_taxorder = sum(is.na(taxorder)),
    missing_taxsubgrp = sum(is.na(taxsubgrp))
  )
```

```{r}
# --- series key inside ped_taxa history ---
taxa_series_lookup <- ncss_ped_taxa %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname = na_if(str_squish(taxonname), ""),
    taxonname_key = toupper(taxonname),

    taxclname   = na_if(str_squish(taxclname), ""),
    taxorder    = na_if(str_squish(taxorder), ""),
    taxsuborder = na_if(str_squish(taxsuborder), ""),
    taxgrtgroup = na_if(str_squish(taxgrtgroup), ""),
    taxsubgrp   = na_if(str_squish(taxsubgrp), ""),
    taxpartsize = na_if(str_squish(taxpartsize), "")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxonname_key)) %>%
  group_by(taxonname_key) %>%
  summarise(
    # "best available" per series from the whole history table
    taxclname   = first(na.omit(taxclname)),
    taxorder    = first(na.omit(taxorder)),
    taxsuborder = first(na.omit(taxsuborder)),
    taxgrtgroup = first(na.omit(taxgrtgroup)),
    taxsubgrp   = first(na.omit(taxsubgrp)),
    taxpartsize = first(na.omit(taxpartsize)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- fill your coastal plain pedon table using the global lookup ---
pedon_taxa_globalfilled <- pedon_taxa_seriesfilled %>%
  left_join(taxa_series_lookup, by = "taxonname_key", suffix = c("", "_global")) %>%
  mutate(
    taxclname   = coalesce(taxclname,   taxclname_global),
    taxorder    = coalesce(taxorder,    taxorder_global),
    taxsuborder = coalesce(taxsuborder, taxsuborder_global),
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, taxgrtgroup_global),
    taxsubgrp   = coalesce(taxsubgrp,   taxsubgrp_global),
    taxpartsize = coalesce(taxpartsize, taxpartsize_global)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with("_global"))

# QC: which are still missing?
pedon_taxa_globalfilled %>%
  filter(is.na(taxclname) | is.na(taxorder)) %>%
  select(peiid, taxonname_clean, taxonname_key, taxclname, taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize) %>%
  arrange(taxonname_key)

pedon_taxa_globalfilled <- pedon_taxa_globalfilled %>%
  mutate(
    taxclname = ifelse(
      !is.na(taxclname),
      str_replace(str_squish(taxclname), "\\.+$", ""),
      taxclname
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# map great-group ending -> suborder (covers your cases)

gg_to_suborder2 <- function(gg) {
  gg0 <- tolower(str_squish(gg))
  gg0 <- str_replace_all(gg0, "[^a-z]", "")  # remove punctuation

  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(gg0, "udults$")   ~ "Udults",
    str_detect(gg0, "ustults$")  ~ "Ustults",
    str_detect(gg0, "xerults$")  ~ "Xerults",
    str_detect(gg0, "torults$")  ~ "Torults",
    str_detect(gg0, "aquults$")  ~ "Aquults",
    str_detect(gg0, "humults$")  ~ "Humults",
    str_detect(gg0, "paleudults$") ~ "Udults",   # explicit (redundant but safe)
    str_detect(gg0, "paleults$") ~ "Udults",     # <-- THIS FIXES SUNSWEET

    str_detect(gg0, "udalfs$")   ~ "Udalfs",
    str_detect(gg0, "ustalfs$")  ~ "Ustalfs",
    str_detect(gg0, "xeralfs$")  ~ "Xeralfs",
    str_detect(gg0, "aqualfs$")  ~ "Aqualfs",

    str_detect(gg0, "udepts$")   ~ "Udepts",
    str_detect(gg0, "ustepts$")  ~ "Ustepts",
    str_detect(gg0, "xerepts$")  ~ "Xerepts",
    str_detect(gg0, "aquepts$")  ~ "Aquepts",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

suborder_to_order2 <- function(so) {
  so0 <- tolower(str_squish(so))
  so0 <- str_replace_all(so0, "[^a-z]", "")

  dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(so0, "ults$") ~ "Ultisols",
    str_detect(so0, "alfs$") ~ "Alfisols",
    str_detect(so0, "epts$") ~ "Inceptisols",  # <-- YOU CALLED IT
    str_detect(so0, "ents$") ~ "Entisols",
    str_detect(so0, "olls$") ~ "Mollisols",
    str_detect(so0, "ods$")  ~ "Spodosols",
    str_detect(so0, "ists$") ~ "Histosols",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}


pedon_taxa_fixedranks <- pedon_taxa_globalfilled %>%
  transmute(
    siteobsiidref, upedonid,
    peiid,
    taxonname, taxonname_key, taxonname_clean,
    taxclname,
    taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, taxsubgrp, taxpartsize,
    POINT_X, POINT_Y
  )
pedon_taxa_fixedranks2 <- pedon_taxa_fixedranks %>%
  mutate(
    taxclname = na_if(str_squish(taxclname), ""),
    taxclname = ifelse(!is.na(taxclname), str_replace(taxclname, "\\.+$", ""), taxclname),

    # subgroup phrase = before first comma
    subgrp_from_taxcl = ifelse(
      (is.na(taxsubgrp) | is.na(taxgrtgroup) | is.na(taxsuborder) | is.na(taxorder)) & !is.na(taxclname),
      str_trim(str_extract(taxclname, "^[^,]+")),
      NA_character_
    ),

    gg_from_taxcl = ifelse(!is.na(subgrp_from_taxcl), word(subgrp_from_taxcl, -1), NA_character_),

    suborder_from_taxcl = ifelse(is.na(taxsuborder) & !is.na(gg_from_taxcl), gg_to_suborder2(gg_from_taxcl), NA_character_),
    order_from_taxcl    = ifelse(is.na(taxorder)    & !is.na(suborder_from_taxcl), suborder_to_order2(suborder_from_taxcl), NA_character_)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxsubgrp   = coalesce(taxsubgrp, subgrp_from_taxcl),
    taxgrtgroup = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, gg_from_taxcl),
    taxsuborder = coalesce(taxsuborder, suborder_from_taxcl),
    taxorder    = coalesce(taxorder, order_from_taxcl)
  ) %>%
  select(-subgrp_from_taxcl, -gg_from_taxcl, -suborder_from_taxcl, -order_from_taxcl)
pedon_taxa_fixedranks2 <- pedon_taxa_fixedranks2 %>%
  left_join(ncss_pedon %>% transmute(peiid, taxonname_ped = taxonname), by="peiid") %>%
  mutate(
    taxonname = coalesce(taxonname, taxonname_ped),
    taxonname_key = coalesce(taxonname_key, toupper(str_squish(taxonname))),
    taxonname_clean = coalesce(taxonname_clean, str_to_title(taxonname_key))
  ) %>%
  select(-taxonname_ped)

  filter(peiid %in% c(517822, 517836, 518338, 979143)) %>%
```

```{r}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (length(a) == 0 || is.na(a)) b else a

parse_subgrp <- function(x, gg_hint = NA_character_) {
  x <- x %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>% str_squish() %>% na_if("")

  if (is.na(x)) {
    return(tibble(
      taxsubgrp_clean = NA_character_,
      subgrp_n_words  = NA_integer_,
      subgrp_gg       = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod_phrase = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod1 = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod2 = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod3 = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod4 = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod_extra = NA_character_
    ))
  }

  toks <- unlist(str_split(x, "\\s+"))
  n <- length(toks)

  gg_hint <- gg_hint %>% str_squish() %>% na_if("")
  gg <- if (!is.na(gg_hint)) gg_hint else toks[n]

  mods <- if (n >= 2) toks[1:(n - 1)] else character(0)

  tibble(
    taxsubgrp_clean = x,
    subgrp_n_words  = n,
    subgrp_gg       = gg,
    subgrp_mod_phrase = if (length(mods) > 0) paste(mods, collapse = " ") else NA_character_,
    subgrp_mod1 = mods[1] %||% NA_character_,
    subgrp_mod2 = mods[2] %||% NA_character_,
    subgrp_mod3 = mods[3] %||% NA_character_,
    subgrp_mod4 = mods[4] %||% NA_character_,
    subgrp_mod_extra = if (length(mods) > 4) paste(mods[5:length(mods)], collapse = " ") else NA_character_
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(str_squish(as.character(.x)), "")))
}

# ---- FIX: drop old parsed columns if they already exist ----
cols_old <- c(
  "taxsubgrp_clean","subgrp_n_words","subgrp_gg","subgrp_mod_phrase",
  "subgrp_mod1","subgrp_mod2","subgrp_mod3","subgrp_mod4","subgrp_mod_extra"
)

pedon_taxa_fixedranks3 <- pedon_taxa_fixedranks3 %>%
  select(-any_of(cols_old)) %>%   # <- prevents duplicate-name error
  mutate(
    taxsubgrp_clean0  = taxsubgrp  %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>% str_squish() %>% na_if(""),
    taxgrtgroup_clean = taxgrtgroup %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>% str_squish() %>% na_if("")
  ) %>%
  mutate(parsed = pmap(list(taxsubgrp_clean0, taxgrtgroup_clean), parse_subgrp)) %>%
  unnest_wider(parsed) %>%
  mutate(
    # enforce gg = taxgrtgroup when present
    subgrp_gg = coalesce(taxgrtgroup_clean, subgrp_gg)
  ) %>%
  select(-taxsubgrp_clean0, -taxgrtgroup_clean)
```

```{r}
    ncss_phsample %>% select(labsampnum, phiidref),

layerlab_with_pedid <- layerlab_with_peiid %>%
  left_join(
    ncss_phorizon %>% select(phiid, peiidref),
    by = c("phiidref" = "phiid")
  ) %>%

# 1) pedons to keep (ALL)
ped_keep <- pedon_taxa_fixedranks3 %>%
  select(peiid,
         taxonname_clean, taxonname_key, taxclname,
         taxorder, taxsuborder, taxgrtgroup, #taxsubgrp,
         subgrp_gg, subgrp_mod1, subgrp_mod2, subgrp_mod3,
         taxpartsize,POINT_X, POINT_Y) %>%
  distinct(peiid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 2) Option A: pedon list drives result -> keeps ALL pedons
layerlab_with_taxa_keepall <- ped_keep %>%
  left_join(
    layerlab_with_pedid,
    by = "peiid",
    relationship = "one-to-many"
  )

cat("Pedons with >=1 lab row:",
    n_distinct(layerlab_with_taxa_keepall$peiid[!is.na(layerlab_with_taxa_keepall$ncsslayerlabdataiid)]),
    "\n")
cat("Pedons with no lab rows:",
    n_distinct(layerlab_with_taxa_keepall$peiid[is.na(layerlab_with_taxa_keepall$ncsslayerlabdataiid)]),
    "\n")
```

```{r}
# pick "best" color per horizon (phiidref)
color_best <- ncss_color %>%
  mutate(
    moist_rank = case_when(
      str_to_lower(colormoistst) == "moist" ~ 1L,
      str_to_lower(colormoistst) == "dry"   ~ 2L,
      TRUE                                  ~ 3L
    ),
    phys_rank = case_when(
      str_to_lower(colorphysst) == "interior" ~ 1L,
      str_to_lower(colorphysst) == "exterior" ~ 2L,
      TRUE                                    ~ 3L
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(phiidref, moist_rank, phys_rank) %>%
  group_by(phiidref) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(phiidref, colorhue, colorvalue, colorchroma)

layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall %>%
```

```{r}


parse_one_side2 <- function(tok) {

  tok0 <- tok %>%
    str_replace_all("\\u00A0", " ") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", "")     # remove internal spaces (e.g., "1B' t1" -> "1B't1")

  if (is.na(tok0) || tok0 == "") {
    return(tibble(
      lith = NA_character_,
      master = NA_character_,          # SINGLE LETTER: O/A/E/B/C/R
      trans_master = NA_character_,    # TWO LETTERS for transitions: BA, AE, BC, EB...
      master_code = NA_character_,     # convenience: first master letter + early suffix (e.g., Bt, Ap)
      suffix = NA_character_,          # subordinate letters (t, tg, p, w, h, g, etc.)
      zone = NA_integer_,
      sub = NA_integer_,
      has_prime = FALSE
    ))
  }

  has_prime <- str_detect(tok0, "'")
  tok_np <- str_remove_all(tok0, "'")

  # lithologic discontinuity prefix (e.g., 2Bt, 3C)
  lith <- str_extract(tok_np, "^\\d+")
  rest <- str_remove(tok_np, "^\\d+")

  # --- MASTER handling ---
  # Transitional if starts with 2 uppercase letters (BA, AE, EB, BC, etc.)
  trans_master <- if_else(str_detect(rest, "^[A-Z]{2}"), str_sub(rest, 1, 2), NA_character_)
  if (!is.na(trans_master)) {
    master <- str_sub(trans_master, 1, 1)
    rest2  <- str_sub(rest, 3)
    early_suffix <- ""   # transitions don't have lowercase master-code letters
    master_code <- trans_master
  } else {
    # Normal: first uppercase letter is the true master (A/B/C/E/O/R)
    master <- if_else(str_detect(rest, "^[A-Z]"), str_sub(rest, 1, 1), NA_character_)
    rest2  <- if_else(!is.na(master), str_sub(rest, 2), rest)

    # Lowercase letters immediately after master BEFORE digits are part of suffix (Bt, Ap, Btg, Bw, Bh, Bg, etc.)
    early_suffix <- str_extract(rest2, "^[a-z]+")
    early_suffix <- if_else(is.na(early_suffix), "", early_suffix)
    rest2 <- str_remove(rest2, "^[a-z]+")  # remove those lowercase letters

    master_code <- if_else(is.na(master), NA_character_, paste0(master, early_suffix))
  }

  # --- Numeric subdivision handling (legacy + underscore) ---
  zone <- NA_integer_
  sub  <- NA_integer_

  # CASE A: underscore form already present (e.g., 2_1tg)
  if (str_detect(rest2, "^\\d+_\\d+")) {
    zone <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(rest2, "^\\d+(?=_)")))
    sub  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(rest2, "(?<=_)\\d+")))
    tail <- str_replace(rest2, "^\\d+_\\d+", "")

  } else if (str_detect(rest2, "^\\d{2,}")) {
    # CASE B: legacy 2+ digits (B22tg, Bt11, Btg12)
    digs <- str_extract(rest2, "^\\d{2,}")
    tail <- str_remove(rest2, "^\\d{2,}")

    # split: all but last digit = zone, last digit = sub
    zone_chr <- str_sub(digs, 1, -2)
    sub_chr  <- str_sub(digs, -1)
    zone <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(zone_chr))
    sub  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub_chr))

  } else if (str_detect(rest2, "^\\d")) {
    # CASE C: single-digit zone only (Bt2, B3, C1)
    zone <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(rest2, "^\\d+")))
    tail <- str_remove(rest2, "^\\d+")

  } else {
    tail <- rest2
  }

  # Anything left is suffix AFTER the digits; combine with early suffix
  tail_suffix <- if_else(is.na(tail) | tail == "", "", tail)

  suffix_full <- paste0(early_suffix, tail_suffix)
  suffix_full <- if_else(suffix_full == "", NA_character_, suffix_full)
  # --- POST FIX for transitional masters like BCtx1, BCt2, BCg, BCtv ---
  # If we have a transitional master and zone/sub are still NA,
  # try to peel trailing digits off the suffix as zone/subdivision.
  if (!is.na(trans_master) && is.na(zone) && !is.na(suffix_full)) {

    # e.g., "tx1" -> suf="tx", zone=1
    #       "t2"  -> suf="t",  zone=2
    #       "cg"  -> no digits, leave as is
    #       "tx12" -> zone=1 sub=2 (legacy 2+ digits)
    suf <- suffix_full

    if (str_detect(suf, "\\d{2,}$")) {
      digs <- str_extract(suf, "\\d{2,}$")
      suf2 <- str_remove(suf, "\\d{2,}$")

      zone_chr <- str_sub(digs, 1, -2)
      sub_chr  <- str_sub(digs, -1)
      zone <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(zone_chr))
      sub  <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub_chr))
      suffix_full <- if_else(suf2 == "", NA_character_, suf2)

    } else if (str_detect(suf, "\\d+$")) {
      zone <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(suf, "\\d+$")))
      suf2 <- str_remove(suf, "\\d+$")
      suffix_full <- if_else(suf2 == "", NA_character_, suf2)
    }
  }
  tibble(
    lith = if_else(is.na(lith) | lith == "", NA_character_, lith),
    master = master,
    trans_master = trans_master,
    master_code = master_code,
    suffix = suffix_full,
    zone = zone,
    sub = sub,
    has_prime = has_prime
  )
}

parse_hzname2 <- function(hz) {

  hz0 <- hz %>%
    str_replace_all("\\u00A0", " ") %>%
    str_squish()

  parts <- str_split(hz0, "\\s*/\\s*", simplify = FALSE)[[1]]

  left  <- parse_one_side2(parts[1])
  right <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parse_one_side2(parts[2]) else NULL

  out <- tibble(
    hzname_clean = hz0,
    hz_is_compound = length(parts) >= 2
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(left %>% rename_with(~paste0("L_", .x))) %>%
    bind_cols(
      if (!is.null(right)) right %>% rename_with(~paste0("R_", .x))
      else tibble(
        R_lith=NA_character_, R_master=NA_character_, R_trans_master=NA_character_,
        R_master_code=NA_character_, R_suffix=NA_character_,
        R_zone=NA_integer_, R_sub=NA_integer_, R_has_prime=FALSE
      )
    )

  out
}
hz_lookup2 <- tibble(hzname = unique(layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color$hzname)) %>%
  mutate(parsed = map(hzname, parse_hzname2)) %>%
  unnest_wider(parsed)  # no name collision because parsed has hzname_clean, not hzname

layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color2 <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color %>%
  left_join(hz_lookup2, by = "hzname") %>%
  mutate(
    # transitional flag (left side)
    hz_is_transitional = !is.na(L_trans_master),

    # Base code you probably want for “horizon type”:
    # - transitions keep their two-letter master (BC, AE, EB, etc.)
    # - otherwise master letter + suffix (Bt, Btg, Ap, Bw, Bh, etc.)
    hz_base = case_when(
      !is.na(L_trans_master) ~ L_trans_master,
      !is.na(L_master) ~ paste0(L_master, coalesce(L_suffix, "")),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
#more parsing to do, such as hot-encoding disturbance, suffix meanings, etc. but this is a good start and we have the base code extracted for most horizons now.
#save as csv
layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color2 <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color2 %>%
  mutate(
    is_legacy_B2 = (L_master == "B" & !is.na(L_zone) & !is.na(L_sub) & is.na(L_suffix)),
    # optional "best guess" interpretation, not taxonomy-true but handy:
    hz_guess = case_when(
      is_legacy_B2 ~ "Bw",                 # common modern analog if no other info
      hz_base == "B" ~ "B",
      TRUE ~ hz_base
    )
  )
write.csv(layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color2, "../outputs/layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color_parsed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# --- 0. helper: robust parser (returns exactly the 4 things you want) ---
parse_subgrp_simple <- function(x, gg_hint = NA_character_) {
  x0 <- x %>% str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>% str_squish() %>% na_if("")
  if (is.na(x0)) {
    return(tibble(
      subgrp_gg = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod1 = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod2 = NA_character_,
      subgrp_mod3 = NA_character_
    ))
  }
  toks <- unlist(str_split(x0, "\\s+"))
  n <- length(toks)
  # assume last token is great-group (gg); mods are preceding tokens
  gg <- if (!is.na(gg_hint) && gg_hint != "") gg_hint else toks[n]
  mods <- if (n >= 2) toks[1:(n-1)] else character(0)

  tibble(
    subgrp_gg   = gg,
    subgrp_mod1 = mods[1] %||% NA_character_,
    subgrp_mod2 = mods[2] %||% NA_character_,
    subgrp_mod3 = mods[3] %||% NA_character_
  )
}

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (length(a) == 0 || is.na(a)) b else a
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#parse out subgroup:

layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color3 <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color3 %>%
  mutate(
    taxsubgrp_clean = taxsubgrp %>%
      str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
      str_squish(),
    taxsubgrp_clean = if_else(is.na(taxsubgrp_clean) | taxsubgrp_clean == "", NA_character_, taxsubgrp_clean),

    # Great group is the last "word" in the subgroup phrase
    subgrp_gg = if_else(
      !is.na(taxsubgrp_clean),
      word(taxsubgrp_clean, -1),
      NA_character_
    ),

    # Everything before the last word are subgroup modifiers (0..N words)
    subgrp_mod_phrase = if_else(
      !is.na(taxsubgrp_clean),
      str_trim(str_remove(taxsubgrp_clean, paste0("\\s+", subgrp_gg, "\\s*$"))),
      NA_character_
    ),

    # count modifiers (for QC)
    subgrp_n_mod = if_else(
      is.na(subgrp_mod_phrase) | subgrp_mod_phrase == "",
      0L,
      str_count(subgrp_mod_phrase, "\\S+")  # count words
    )
  ) %>%
  # split modifiers into columns (up to 4; add more if you want)
  separate(
    col = subgrp_mod_phrase,
    into = c("subgrp_mod1", "subgrp_mod2", "subgrp_mod3", "subgrp_mod4"),
    sep = "\\s+",
    fill = "right",
    extra = "merge",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("subgrp_mod"), ~ na_if(.x, "")),
    # convenience flags you mentioned
    is_arenic = str_detect(tolower(coalesce(taxsubgrp_clean, "")), "\\barenic\\b"),
```

```{r}
#depth to Bt and depth to argillic:

max_depth_cm <- 150

hz_indices <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color3 %>%
  mutate(
    # overlap with 0–150 for thickness-based summaries
    top = pmax(hzdept, 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    bot = pmin(hzdepb, max_depth_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    thk_0_150 = pmax(0, bot - top),

    # robust “is this Bt?” using your parsed master code
    is_Bt = str_to_lower(coalesce(L_master_code, "")) == "bt",

    # argillic-ish: any 't' in suffix (Bt, B't, Btx, Btg, etc.)
    # NOTE: this is a working rule; later you can refine to true argillic criteria.
    is_argillic = str_detect(str_to_lower(coalesce(L_suffix, "")), "t"),

    is_E = str_to_lower(coalesce(L_master, "")) == "e" |
           str_to_lower(coalesce(L_master_code, "")) == "e",

    is_gleyed = str_detect(str_to_lower(coalesce(L_suffix, "")), "g")
  ) %>%
  group_by(peiid) %>%
  summarise(
    # --- DEPTH-TO (top of first matching horizon) ---
    depth_to_Bt_cm = if (any(is_Bt & is.finite(hzdept), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(hzdept[is_Bt], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,

    depth_to_argillic_cm = if (any(is_argillic & is.finite(hzdept), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(hzdept[is_argillic], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,

    depth_to_E_cm = if (any(is_E & is.finite(hzdept), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(hzdept[is_E], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,

    depth_to_gley_cm = if (any(is_gleyed & is.finite(hzdept), na.rm = TRUE)) {
      min(hzdept[is_gleyed], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else NA_real_,

    # --- THICKNESS WITHIN 0–150 ---
    bt_thk_0_150_cm = sum(thk_0_150[is_Bt], na.rm = TRUE),
    argillic_thk_0_150_cm = sum(thk_0_150[is_argillic], na.rm = TRUE),

    # --- FLAGS ---
    has_Bt_0_150 = any(is_Bt & thk_0_150 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_argillic_0_150 = any(is_argillic & thk_0_150 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_E_0_150 = any(is_E & thk_0_150 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_gley_0_150 = any(is_gleyed & thk_0_150 > 0, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# helper functions
first_non_na <- function(x) {
  y <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  if (length(y) == 0) NA else y[1]
}

wmean_safe <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(w)
  if (!any(ok)) NA_real_ else weighted.mean(x[ok], w[ok])
}

max_depth_cm <- 150

layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color3 <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color3 %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))

hz_indices <- hz_indices %>%
  mutate(peiid = as.character(peiid))

pedon_pack_150 <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color3 %>%
  mutate(
    top = pmax(hzdept, 0),
    bot = pmin(hzdepb, max_depth_cm),
    thk = pmax(0, bot - top)
  ) %>%
  filter(thk > 0) %>%
  group_by(peiid) %>%
  summarise(
    taxonname_clean = first_non_na(taxonname_clean),
    taxorder        = first_non_na(taxorder),
    taxsuborder     = first_non_na(taxsuborder),
    taxgrtgroup     = first_non_na(taxgrtgroup),
    taxsubgrp_mod1  = first_non_na(taxsubgrp_mod1),
    taxsubgrp_mod2  = first_non_na(taxsubgrp_mod2),
    taxsubgrp_mod3  = first_non_na(taxsubgrp_mod3),
    taxpartsize     = first_non_na(taxpartsize),

    sand_w = wmean_safe(sandtotmeasured, thk),
    silt_w = wmean_safe(silttotmeasured, thk),
    clay_w = wmean_safe(claytotmeasured, thk),
    cec7_w = wmean_safe(cec7, thk),

    R_w = wmean_safe(R, thk),
    G_w = wmean_safe(G, thk),
    B_w = wmean_safe(B, thk),

    any_argillic  = any(str_detect(coalesce(L_suffix, ""), "t"), na.rm = TRUE),
    any_gleyed    = any(str_detect(coalesce(L_suffix, ""), "g"), na.rm = TRUE),
    any_fragipan  = any(str_detect(coalesce(L_suffix, ""), "x"), na.rm = TRUE),
    any_carbonate = any(str_detect(coalesce(L_suffix, ""), "k"), na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )

hz_props_150 <- layerlab_with_taxa_keepall_color3 %>%
  mutate(
    top = pmax(hzdept, 0),
    bot = pmin(hzdepb, max_depth_cm),
    thk = pmax(0, bot - top),
    hz_base2 = if_else(is.na(hz_base) | hz_base == "", "Unknown", hz_base)
  ) %>%
  filter(thk > 0) %>%
  group_by(peiid, hz_base2) %>%
  summarise(thk = sum(thk), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(peiid) %>%
  mutate(prop = thk / sum(thk)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(peiid, hz_base2, prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = hz_base2,
    values_from = prop,
    values_fill = 0,
    names_prefix = "prop_hzbase_"
  )

pedon_pack_150 <- pedon_pack_150 %>%
  left_join(hz_props_150, by = "peiid") %>%
  left_join(hz_indices, by = "peiid")

write.csv(pedon_pack_150, "../outputs/pedon_pack_150_02_26_26.csv", row.names = FALSE)

if (ncol(X) < 2) stop("X still has fewer than 2 columns after recipe.")
if (nrow(X) < 3) stop("X still has too few rows for UMAP.")

nn <- min(25, nrow(X) - 1)

u <- uwot::umap(
  X,
  n_neighbors = nn,
  min_dist = 0.1,
  metric = "cosine",
  n_threads = 0
)

pedon_umap <- bind_cols(ids, dfp, tibble(UMAP1 = u[,1], UMAP2 = u[,2]))

ggplot(pedon_umap, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = taxsubgrp_mod1)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "taxsubgrp_mod1", title = "Pedon-level UMAP (0–150 cm packaged)")
```


```{r}
#delineate  Ultisols into suborders based on great group name but keep other tax orders constant and plot:


pedon_umap3 <- pedon_umap %>%
  mutate(
    is_ult = (taxorder == "Ultisols") | str_detect(tolower(coalesce(taxgrtgroup, "")), "ult"),
    order_group = coalesce(taxorder, "Unknown order"),
    ult_group   = coalesce(taxgrtgroup, "Unknown GG"),
    shape_group = if_else(is_ult, "Ultisols (GG)", "Non-Ultisols (Order)")
  )

ggplot() +
  # --- NON-ULTISOLS: color by ORDER (palette 1) ---
  geom_point(
    data = filter(pedon_umap3, !is_ult),
    aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = order_group, shape = shape_group),
    alpha = 0.85, size = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = "Tax order (non-Ultisols)") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("Non-Ultisols (Order)" = 16, "Ultisols (GG)" = 17),
    name = "Grouping"
  ) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +

  # --- ULTISOLS: color by GREAT GROUP (palette 2) ---
  geom_point(
    data = filter(pedon_umap3, is_ult),
    aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = ult_group, shape = shape_group),
    alpha = 0.95, size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.95, name = "Ultisols great group") +

  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Pedon-level UMAP (0–150 cm): Orders + Ultisols by great group")

  # --- color by RGB:
ggplot(pedon_umap, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = B_w),
    alpha = 0.85, size = 2
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "Weighted avg color (0–150 cm)", title = "Pedon-level UMAP colored by RGB") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4)))
```
